ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, AB is the diameter of $\odot O$, CD is a chord of $\odot O$, and $\angle ACD = 40^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle BAD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Connect BD,\\
since the angles subtended by the same arc in a circle are equal,\\
therefore, $\angle B = \angle C = 40^\circ$,\\
since AB is a diameter,\\
therefore, $\angle ADB = 90^\circ$,\\
thus, $\angle DAB + \angle B = 90^\circ$,\\
therefore, $\angle DAB = 90^\circ - 40^\circ = \boxed{50^\circ}$.
